lines.say: Someone bought the sun. Now your street pays for daylight.
Seven a.m. Your window turns black until you pay.
Sunlight costs nine dollars an hour. Shade is free.
You walk to work in the dark. The rich blocks glow like noon.
Then a kid on your street hangs a mirror. And bounces the light to you.
The tower sends a notice. Mirrors are theft of the sun.
Would you share the light? Write it in the comments.
